messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bulgarian, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bulgarian line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑condition) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------|-------------------------------|--------| | In | locative preposition “in/within” all parts | във | “in/into” | OK | | tutte | universal quantifier “all” (feminine plural) | всички | “all” | OK | | parti | set of spatial divisions | части | “parts” | OK | | impera | 3sg present “governs/holds sway over” | владее | “governs” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | и | “and” | OK | | quivi | adverb “there (at that place)” | там | “there” | OK | | regge | 3sg present “reigns/holds authority” | царува | “reigns” | OK | | quivi | adverb “there (at that place)” | там | “there” | OK | | è | copular verb “is/exists” | е | “is” | OK | | la | definite article (feminine singular) – not required in Bulgarian | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sua | possessive adjective “his/her” (feminine) | неговият | “his” | OK | | città | noun “city” (feminine) | град | “city” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | и | “and” | OK | | l’ | definite article (masc. singular) – not required in Bulgarian | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | alto | adjective “lofty/high” (masc. singular) | високият | “lofty” | OK | | seggio | noun “seat/throne” (masc. singular) | трон | “seat, throne” | OK | | oh | interjection of address “O” | о | “O” | OK | | felice | adjective “happy, fortunate” (masc. sing.) | щастлив | “happy” | OK | | colui | demonstrative pronoun “he who/that one” (masc. sing.) | онзи | “that one” | OK | | cu’ | relative pronoun “who/whom” (contraction of *che*) | когото | “whom” | OK | | ivi | adverb “there, at that place” | там | “there” | OK | | elegge | 3sg present “elects/chooses” | избира | “elects” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: - **la** (definite article before *città*) – Bulgarian does not use an article here. - **l’** (definite article before *alto*) – Bulgarian does not use an article before adjectives/nouns in this construction.
No source words are **MISSING**, no translations are **WRONG**, and there are no **GRAMMAR** issues in the Bulgarian rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bulgarian script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bulgarian text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
